result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The change is in `DataStore.countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`: the count subquery has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other per-rep counts use. I also added a line to the method's Javadoc saying cancelled orders are left out.

Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged. I ran the `*DataStore*` tests and they passed. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.
